info.name: Marketo Engage Rest Approve Landing  Page  Redirect  Rules API
Marketo Get Landing Page Redirect Rules

params.name: maxReturn
params.description: Maximum number of landing page redirect rules to return. Max 200, default 20

params.name: redirectTolandingPageId
params.description: Landing page id of landing page to redirect to

params.name: redirectToPath
params.description: Path of landing page to redirect to

params.name: earliestUpdatedAt
params.description: Exclude landing page redirect rules prior to this date. Must be valid ISO-8601 string. See Datetime field type description.

params.name: latestUpdatedAt
params.description: Exclude landing page redirect rules after this date. Must be valid ISO-8601 string. See Datetime field type description.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of landing page redirect rules from the target instance. Required Permissions: Read Only Redirect Rules, Read Write Redirect Rules
